raw.location: SP7 lab disk; intentionally outside Git

proved: Every observed Tintless call consumed the immediately preceding Titan680 parser output pointer.
All 150 producer/consumer pairs were in the same FrameServer process and same thread.
Parser generations 82, 84 and 104 were superseded by a newer parser output before any Tintless call consumed them.
A parser hit counter is therefore not a valid request identifier or FIFO-consumption contract.
not_proved: No numerical request-to-statistics delay is promoted to authority by this trace.
The previously inferred four-request delay remains unproven.
linux_consequence: Expose completed TL_BG as an explicitly generation-tagged latest snapshot; consumers must detect generation changes/skips and must not infer request identity from parser count.
